overview: An image-based fashion search application that retrieves visually similar garments from a local catalogue. Users can search the full photo or select one garment before retrieval.
problem: Several garments and background details can distract whole-image search. Selecting the intended piece gives the encoder a more focused query.
objectives: Retrieve visually similar clothing from an image.
Refine the target with positive and negative SAM2 points.
Support local product entry and management.
Evaluate search with clearly defined relevance.

evidence.limit: Category relevance, not exact-product identity or a general 75% accuracy guarantee.
